mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(g.active_cutoff_id,(SELECT c.cutoff_id FROM reconciliation_cutoff c WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{e} AND c.warehouse_id=#{w} AND c.collection_state='COMPLETE' ORDER BY c.closed_at DESC,c.cutoff_id DESC LIMIT 1)) FROM reconciliation_history_guard g WHERE g.enterprise_id=#{e} AND g.warehouse_id=#{w}
SELECT * FROM reconciliation_history_guard WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reconciliation_history_guard SET active_cutoff_id=#{id}, closed_before=GREATEST(COALESCE(closed_before,#{cutoff}),#{cutoff}),version=version+1 WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND (active_cutoff_id IS NULL OR active_cutoff_id=#{id})
UPDATE reconciliation_history_guard SET active_cutoff_id=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND active_cutoff_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reconciliation_cutoff WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND cutoff_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reconciliation_cutoff SET collection_state='RUNNING',claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,collection_attempts=collection_attempts+1, next_attempt_at=#{until},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND cutoff_id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND collection_state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND collection_attempts < 12

UPDATE reconciliation_cutoff SET collection_state=#{state},collection_progress=CAST(#{progress} AS JSON), collection_attempts=IF(#{advanced},0,collection_attempts),collection_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{next},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND cutoff_id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND collection_state='RUNNING'

UPDATE reconciliation_cutoff SET collection_state=#{state},claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1, collection_attempts=0,collection_error=NULL,next_attempt_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND cutoff_id=#{id} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND collection_state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','ISOLATED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_execution_fact(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,source_service,command_id,business_effect_key,fact_kind,quantity,occurred_at,watermark_token,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{f.id},#{e},#{w},#{source},#{f.commandId},#{f.effectId},'PHYSICAL',#{f.quantity},#{f.occurredAt},#{f.watermark},0,#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
